source_pr.title: Trigger4: WP507 G3 recipient-scoped uptake and causal evidence

validation.explicit_no_broadcast_control: ALREADY_STRUCTURALLY_ENFORCED: CausalProbeArm.control emits CONTROL_NO_BROADCAST and rejects broadcast binding on control arm
validation.order_state_seed_baseline_stability: NOT_COVERED_BY_PR226_SOURCE_TESTS_OBSERVED: CausalProbeArm binds nonbroadcast input digest and output digest but carries no run-order, seed, initial-state digest, attempt identity, or repeated-control stability receipt

correction_to_prior_delta.corrected_assessment: three proposed classes were already materially represented by current WP507 G3 source/tests; the genuinely useful residual from CITCOM is run/order/state/seed or repeated-control baseline stability, especially for future nondeterministic/stateful execution layers
correction_to_prior_delta.effect_on_adoption: strengthens CONCEPT_DISTILL_ONLY_NOW and weakens justification for any direct dependency or broad E3 fixture

new_minimal_discriminator.scope: WP507 FUTURE RUNTIME/NONDETERMINISTIC LAYER, NOT CURRENT CONTRACT CI
new_minimal_discriminator.hypothesis: A matched causal arm can report a contract-scope difference even when an unbound initial state, run order, random seed, or baseline drift caused the difference rather than the broadcast intervention.
new_minimal_discriminator.counterhypothesis: Current deterministic repository component scope intentionally excludes runtime nondeterminism, so adding these fields now would overfit a future concern and increase ABI surface without current evidence.
new_minimal_discriminator.cheapest_falsifier: Before extending the ABI, construct a bounded deterministic stateful fixture where identical declared nonbroadcast_input_sha256 values conceal different mutable initial state between control/intervention. If current contract can falsely return CAUSAL_INFLUENCE_OBSERVED_AT_CONTRACT_SCOPE, record the limitation; only add a state/attempt/seed binding when a target runtime producer can actually supply trustworthy identities.
new_minimal_discriminator.promotion: NO_AUTOMATIC_E3; requires a separate atomic claim and exact scope decision

evidence_boundary: Exact PR226 source/test comparison only. No code change, no test execution, no runtime promotion.
